Frequently Asked Questions.

How does subscription timing and validity work?ExpandCollapse

Your subscription timer starts from the exact timestamp of purchase. Whether you choose 1, 2, 3, 6, or 12 months, our automated timing engine tracks your remaining days with live countdown alerts before expiry.

Which games and platforms are included?ExpandCollapse

Xbox Game Pass Ultimate gives you access to hundreds of PC & Xbox console titles including day-one releases, EA Play, and Xbox Cloud Gaming.

NVIDIA GeForce NOW connects to your Steam, Epic, and Xbox libraries with RTX 5080 cloud performance.

Play on PC, Xbox, smart TVs, and mobile handhelds seamlessly.

How does profile protection work?ExpandCollapse

Every customer receives a dedicated profile slot dedicated solely to you. Other users on the account cannot access your saves, cloud progression, or account settings.

Can I use GeForce NOW on smart TVs or handhelds?ExpandCollapse

Yes! GeForce NOW runs seamlessly on PC, Mac, Android, iOS, smart TVs, Steam Deck, and ROG Ally with ultra-low latency.

What happens when my subscription validity ends?ExpandCollapse

You will receive an automated alert 48 hours before expiry. You can extend your slot anytime with 1-click renewal. If not renewed, your slot enters a 24-hour grace window before being recycled.

Can I upgrade my duration from 1 month to 12 months?ExpandCollapse

Yes! You can extend or upgrade your duration anytime from your dashboard or via WhatsApp, and the additional months will be added directly to your remaining time.

What platforms and services are supported?ExpandCollapse

We provide private slots for Xbox Game Pass Ultimate (Console, PC, Cloud Gaming) and NVIDIA GeForce NOW (Priority and Ultimate RTX 5080 tiers).

How fast do I receive my account credentials?ExpandCollapse

Delivery is instant. Within 60 seconds of completing payment, your credentials and profile slot are delivered to your WhatsApp and Dashboard. Our automated provisioning engine allocates your slot and dispatches your credentials in under 60 seconds.

You will receive immediate setup instructions and access credentials directly on WhatsApp.

Can I extend or renew my existing slot?ExpandCollapse

Yes! You can extend your subscription by 1, 2, 3, or 12 months anytime before or during the 24h grace period, keeping your saves, profile, and game progress intact. All your game saves, profile slots, and cloud sync states remain permanently locked to your slot throughout your renewal.

Is there a warranty or ban-protection guarantee?ExpandCollapse

Yes. All subscriptions include a 100% lifetime replacement warranty for the duration of your active pass against login or authentication issues. If an account experiences authentication locks or login issues, we provide an immediate replacement slot.

Can I use the slot on multiple devices?ExpandCollapse

Yes! You can play on Xbox Consoles, PC, smart TVs, handhelds (Steam Deck, ROG Ally), and mobile devices via GeForce NOW and Xbox Cloud Gaming. Play on Xbox Consoles, PC, smart TVs, handhelds (Steam Deck, ROG Ally), and mobile devices simultaneously.
